findings.problem: resolvedDatePreflight treats state.round>=(maxRounds??3) as a circuit hold, so a native amendment that advances the held preflight to the last allowed reaudit round cannot reserve. runDateWorkflow still enters while round<=maxRounds and only stops further repair after that review, so this CLI/queue gate blocks valid independent review (default maxRounds 3: pin.round 2 -> candidate-3). Worker-blocker supplement, foreign owner/lease skips, provenance/replay checks, and the unchanged negative jinshu/080 blobs are otherwise intact and do not approve the chapter.
findings.requiredFix: Fail the round/circuit hold only when state.round>(options.maxRounds??3) (or otherwise after the last legal reaudit), matching the workflow loop, while still rejecting phase/circuit mismatches, pin.round+1 drift, unresolved flags, missing repair-${pin.round} author provenance, and combined-proposal replay failures.

reason: Cursor --retry-blocked still requires an explicit chapter or a fingerprint-bound supplement; reservation proves the saved preflight, held unresolved candidate, canonical pins, author-bound native repair, resolved flags, and combined replay, and does not take foreign or leased work. The round>=maxRounds check is stricter than the workflow and can refuse a legal last-round independent reaudit after a real revisePendingDateRepair.
